title: Snorkel Big Island

services.name: Morning Snorkel
services.desc: Head up the Kona Coastline and search for Hawaiian Spinner dolphins, marine life, and seasonal whales. Snorkel at one of Kona's many pristine snorkel sites and capture oceanside pictures of the coastline topography, including sea caves and arches. Departing from Honokohau Harbor, enjoy the dramatic coastline views as we cruise the sapphire waters of the Big Island. Be on the lookout for Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins, Humpback Whales (seasonal) or any other marine wildlife that could make a surprise appearance. blurb: Aloha and Welcome to Snorkel Big Island. We are a family owned and locally-operated snorkel company catering to guests on the sunny side of Kona Hawaii. Our goal is to share a professional, safe, and personal snorkel experience to those visiting our beautiful island. With high standards of service, an abundance of Aloha, but most importantly FUN, we pride ourselves on creating epic snorkeling adventures and memories
